notes: Spine: gap -> hypothesis (water fuses fibres; motivated by the post-feeding SEM) -> native AcSp1 silk + treatment sweep -> water soak -> Ala beta-sheet up (n9), helices kept (n10), small 4-6 nm beta domains (n11) -> jointly fibre fusion (n8), explained by MEC n12 (argued, F6 model) -> stiffer (n13, argued, text only) and fusion on prey (n14) -> conclusion. Side: wet-shear branch (n7, n16), water accessibility (n17), 30 s kinetics (n19), dragline comparison (d1). Audits: a1 crystalline-Ala contamination in native trace; a4 tau_m* unit mismatch between F5c axis and text; d2 native domain size unmeasurable. Lost: Table 2 fractions (not in packet), Gly dynamics (Fig. S1), SI domain-size equation. Packet issues: F6a caption says 'little beta-sheet (~75%)'; F6a crop cue 'micrograph'/scale bar on a schematic; F3a OCR letter r; F3b caption garbled ('13(-Va)'); F4 linked text duplicates F3 text; F5 text cites 50/500 us slices not in F5b; F5 offered no panels.
